# <span id="aanchor50"></span> Unit Conversion

The Unit Conversion Calculator converts values from one unit to a different unit (e.g., from degrees Fahrenheit to degrees Celsius).

<div class="procedure">

To access the Unit Conversion Calculator: 

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Unit Conversion** in the **Calculators** group.

To convert a value:

1.  On the left side of the screen, enter the value you want to convert and select the current unit from the drop-down list.

2.  On the right side of the screen, select the new unit from the drop-down list.

3.  The value is converted and displayed automatically.

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Unit Conversion Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available in the Unit Conversion screen:

- **All Units to US** - Set the units on the left side of the screen to U.S. units and the right side to metric units.
- **All Units to Metric** - Set the units on the left side of the screen to metric units and the right side to U.S. units.
- **Clear** - Clear all values.
- **Close** - Close the screen.

</div>
